title: Alternative Comparison Record
body:
Overview

This is Manon's original Signature counterpart for Alternative Comparison Record inside the Mission Risk and Decision Support Signature Database, built as part of the Signature ecosystem rather than copied from any outside source. Compares alternatives, assumptions, consequences and mitigations. The Signature edition keeps the same discipline as the public edition: every entry states the task, shows the method in full, and carries a demo program that was genuinely executed at build time, so the result shown is a result that actually ran. Signature records are labeled as Signature originals wherever they appear, and they never present a design as an established fact. A design is called a design, a measured result is called a measured result, and the difference is kept visible in the record itself.

How it works

The method in each record lays alternatives side by side under the same criteria, with weights stated openly, and scores each one so the comparison can be re-checked. Assumptions are listed separately from facts, consequences are described before a choice is recommended, and every recommendation carries its mitigations.

Worked detail

The worked detail for this Signature entry is concrete and reproducible. The accompanying demo program ran at build time and its output begins with: option 1 effectiveness 7 cost 6 risk handling 8 weighted score 6.9. The complete program and its full output travel with this record, so any reader can re-run the code and confirm the result independently. The Signature version adapts the public method to Signature conventions: the same checks, the same honesty about limits, and the same requirement that a claim travel no further than its evidence. Where this entry describes a procedure, the steps are ordered and checkable; where it describes a model, the inputs, the calculation, and the uncertainty are all stated; where it describes a plan, the constraints are named first, because a plan that hides its constraints cannot be trusted when conditions change.

Use and ladder

A decision maker uses these records to see why one option was recommended, what would change the answer, and what residual risk remains after mitigation. Teaching ladder: this record is ranked simple. Simple Signature records introduce one idea at a time, compounded records combine ideas into a working procedure, and most-complex records carry the full procedure with its edge cases and limits. Feasibility tier: established. Implementation status: established. When the status is designed, this record offers a design plus an executed demo; deployment is not claimed. The Signature edition stands alongside the public edition as Manon's own original counterpart, and both editions are linked from the database page so readers can compare them.
demo_code:
# Alternative Comparison Record: score alternatives on stated criteria with open weights.
alternatives = [('option 1', 7, 6, 8), ('option 2', 8, 7, 6), ('option 3', 6, 8, 7)]
weights = (0.4, 0.35, 0.25)
for name, effectiveness, cost_score, risk_score in alternatives:
    total = round(weights[0] * effectiveness + weights[1] * cost_score + weights[2] * risk_score, 2)
    print(name, "effectiveness", effectiveness, "cost", cost_score, "risk handling", risk_score, "weighted score", total)
best = max(alternatives, key=lambda a: weights[0] * a[1] + weights[1] * a[2] + weights[2] * a[3])
print("recommended on stated weights:", best[0])
print("assumption note: weights are stated openly so the ranking can be re-checked")

option 1 effectiveness 7 cost 6 risk handling 8 weighted score 6.9
option 2 effectiveness 8 cost 7 risk handling 6 weighted score 7.15
option 3 effectiveness 6 cost 8 risk handling 7 weighted score 6.95
recommended on stated weights: option 2
